prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) was helpful, winning both of its tests.
Adding a new screen at finish (finish, new_screen) was helpful, winning 1 of 2 tests.
Wait-time information changes on home (home, wait_info), copy changes on sign-in (sign_in, copy), and copy changes on path selection (choose_path, copy) showed no clear positive effect across 2 tests each.
Evidence remains thin for all change categories tested only once.
Predictions were consistently too high for non-winning tests.
Winning tests were generally underpredicted.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Add Desktop Pet Trait Selector Screen: Adds a new interactive personality trait selection screen right before the final home intro view. (why: Adding new screens near the end of onboarding has proven effective in previous tests, and support reports show demand for more initial pet customization.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign In After Pet Generation Waiting Screen: Moves account sign-in to take place immediately after the pet generation waiting screen finishes. (why: Reordering sign-in later in the funnel won both previous tests by allowing users to build maximum attachment to their generated pet first.)
2: [adoption, redesign] Redesign Pick Friend with Compact Card Layout: Redesigns the pick friend screen layout into a clean compact layout with trait badges. (why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 60.9% and long median duration (89s); a structured compact layout streamlines friend comparison.)
3: [home, new_flow] Add Interactive Mini Activity Flow to Waiting Screen: Introduces an interactive pet feeding mini-activity standard flow directly inside the waiting screen layout. (why: The waiting step has high friction with median 201s and mean 2336s; interactive engagement during waiting keeps users active.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Grid Layout for Path Choice Screen: Switches the path selection screen layout to a grid format for clearer comparison between preset and custom creation. (why: Choose path step takes a mean 514s; presenting distinct paths side-by-side in a grid speeds up decision making.)
5: [sign_in, notification] Sign In Account Security and Cloud Sync Badge: Displays an explicit account sync and pet protection badge on the sign-in screen. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
6: [choose_path, hint] Desktop Overlay Hint on Path Choice Screen: Adds an explanatory hint beneath path selection explaining how pets overlay on top of open desktop applications. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how pets appear on screen or failing to open correctly.)
7: [home, notification] Ready Audio Cue Notification on Waiting Screen: Enables an automatic audio sound cue notification when the pet finishes generating on the waiting screen. (why: Waiting step mean duration is 2336s because users switch windows; an audio notification alerts them when ready.)
